routes.name: Visa-free entry
routes.summary: Citizens of the US, Palau, Micronesia, EU countries and Taiwan don't need a visa. Passport must be valid 6 months, with funds and an onward ticket.

routes.name: Visa on arrival or waiver for countries with diplomatic relations
routes.summary: Citizens of countries with diplomatic relations with RMI can get a visa on arrival or waiver. The list sits with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and wasn't read.

routes.name: V-1 Visitor Visa
routes.summary: Visitor visa for people who must apply before travel. The Immigration Act allows up to 3 months.

routes.name: B-1 Business Visa
routes.summary: For holders of an approved Foreign Investment Business License. Act allows up to 2 years.

routes.name: T-1 Transit Visa
routes.summary: Transit visa class valid up to 3 days under the Immigration Act.

routes.name: E-1 Work Visa
routes.summary: Work visa tied to a work permit, up to 2 years. Fees and process set by regulation and not confirmed.

other: Work permit under the Labor (Non-Resident Workers) Act

routes.name: S-1 Student Visa
routes.summary: Student visa valid up to 1 year under the Immigration Act.

routes.name: G-1 General Visa (spouse and dependents)
routes.summary: For spouses or dependent children of people legally working or stationed in RMI. Up to 2 years.

other: Sponsor legally working or stationed in RMI

routes.name: R-1 Residence Visa
routes.summary: Residence visa valid up to 5 years, for holders of a Certificate of Actual Residence. The Act sets no permanent residence route.

routes.name: Naturalization
routes.summary: 10 years of residence, Marshallese conversation skills, a written test and cabinet approval. Capped at 10 people a year.

citizenship.note: Must renounce other citizenship, with a declaration route if renouncing isn't possible. Public benefit naturalization (max 5 a year) can allow dual.

routes.name: Citizenship by adoption
routes.summary: A person adopted as a child by a citizen can register after 5 years of residence. High Court decides. No marriage route exists.

other: Adopted as a child by a citizen

citizenship.note: Adults must renounce other citizenship. Birth and descent rules are in the Constitution, not read.
